data.statement: Adopt the bounded AI Cleanup component slice to baseline-usable so the approved lossless block replacement development run can proceed.

acceptance: The AI Cleanup component has exact mapped paths, known focused tests and requirements, documented high semantic-deletion risk and human-review controls, passes traceability and coverage audits, passes component scope/baseline checks at baseline-usable, and adoption introduces no runtime behavior change.
assumptions: The approved slice is a single component even though some exact files provide shared AI/config support; only cleanup-specific behavior in those files is within the later development scope.
data.reason: The human explicitly approved this bounded adoption slice; the work is configuration and documentation only, existing cleanup requirements/tests/component documentation are substantial, and no product behavior will change.
scope: In scope: .agentic/components.toml AI Cleanup entry, AI Cleanup knowledge/adoption notes, current requirement and test inventory, and baseline evidence. Out of scope: application behavior changes, prompt/schema replacement, new requirements, new tests, source edits, delivery actions, and unrelated components.
data.source: User approval 2026-07-14: approve the AI Cleanup component-adoption slice and continue automatically through delivery preparation
data.understanding: Adopt one bounded AI Cleanup component before resuming the lossless block replacement change. The adoption slice will map the existing cleanup-specific service, prompt, state/metadata, UI-controller, tests, and component-documentation files, describe their current behavior and risks, and prove that existing requirements, deterministic tests, and documentation make the component baseline-usable without changing runtime behavior.

data.command: .\.agentic\tools\run.ps1 adoption component-status; adoption baseline; adoption scope-check <AI Cleanup paths>; audit traceability; audit coverage
data.summary: Approved AI Cleanup adoption slice is mapped baseline-usable with exact source, prompt, test, state, UI, and documentation paths; scope-check, traceability, and coverage are clean, and the adoption diff contains no application behavior changes.
